description: From the Blue start on Shooters Hill Road: the course's one climb to Charlton Park Lane, the drop into Woolwich, Greenwich and the Cutty Sark, Deptford, the Rotherhithe loop, Bermondsey, Tower Bridge, out along The Highway to Limehouse, through the Westferry underpass, around the Isle of Dogs and Canary Wharf, back along Commercial Road and The Highway, Tower Hill, the Upper Thames Street tunnel and the Blackfriars Underpass, the Victoria Embankment, Parliament Square and Birdcage Walk, finishing on The Mall. Unofficial.

source.notes: 2026 course from the Blue start (the organiser's map for 2027 isn't out yet; both 2027 race days use the same route). Route traced over OpenStreetMap streets in race order, through the Westferry underpass; no measurement certificate is public, so distances are scaled between the start and the finish and compared with the organiser's mile-by-mile road list. Elevations from the Environment Agency's 1 m bare-earth lidar; bridges are interpolated and the Blackfriars Underpass dip is kept. Downhills are flat on a treadmill without decline. Unofficial.
